discrete_form: Multiset of roots of chi(c) = chi_w(c^q).
analytic_lift: Multiset of leading coefficients {c_i} of irregular-type polynomials Q_i(t) = c_i t^p + lower. Determines the *top* component of the Levelt-Turrittin decomposition over Q_w / t^p Q_w.
caveats: The lower-order coefficients of Q_i(t) are NOT determined by chi(c); they require the full operator and are independent invariants.

discrete_form: r concentric rings of size q at radii rho_alpha = |w_alpha|^{1/q}.
analytic_lift: Ring R_alpha corresponds to the Levelt-Turrittin summand of rank q with irregular type Q_alpha(t) = rho_alpha * zeta * t^p over the q branches t -> zeta t, zeta in mu_q. Each ring is a *single* Galois-cyclic summand.
caveats: Equal-modulus stratum (|w_alpha| = |w_beta|) causes ring fusion in MW(L).

analytic_lift: Leading coefficient L_{ij} of Q_i(t) - Q_j(t). In the generic case Q_i - Q_j has degree p and L_{ij} = Delta_{ij}; in degenerate cases L_{ij} comes from a lower-degree term. Anti-Stokes directions are determined by (arg(L_{ij}), deg(Q_i - Q_j)).
lift_strength: exact for the generic case; lower-degree corrections needed off the open stratum
caveats: Multi-edge and accidental cancellations require tracking lower-order Q_i terms.

analytic_lift: Anti-Stokes ray positions on the cover t-plane: phi_{ij,k} = (pi/(2p)) - (1/p) arg(Delta_{ij}) + (k pi)/p, k = 0,1,...,2p-1. Projects to 2p / gcd(2p, q) distinct rays in the base x-plane.
caveats: Multiplicities depend on gcd(2p, q); base-plane projection identifies rays.

analytic_lift: Dominance separation strength: larger |Delta_{ij}| means faster dominance switching across the corresponding anti-Stokes ray. Does NOT determine Stokes multiplier magnitudes (those are global analytic invariants requiring summation theory).
caveats: Stokes constants depend on global analytic data, not just |Delta_{ij}|.

discrete_form: Smallest m such that all arg(c_i)/arg(c_j) differences lie in 2 pi Z/m; flagged when m > q.
analytic_lift: Coincidence pattern of anti-Stokes directions. When m > q the anti-Stokes rays group into clusters of multiplicity m/q, signalling *Stokes group enhancement* (the unipotent Stokes group at that direction has higher dimension than the generic q-direction Stokes group).
lift_strength: qualitative (cluster pattern); quantitative content requires checking lower Q_i terms
caveats: True 'enhancement' requires also that lower Q_i terms align; we only check leading.

discrete_form: Integer Z-linear relations sum n_k c_k = 0 not derivable from per-ring cyclotomic relations.
analytic_lift: Algebraic relations among the leading irregular-type coefficients. These imply algebraic constraints on the *moduli* of the wild character variety: the locus of leading-coefficient configurations compatible with the inner polynomial chi_w lies on a chi_w-stratum in the discrete part of MW(L).
caveats: Z-resonance is about *which* (c_1, ..., c_N) is realised; it does not refine Stokes data within a stratum.

invariant: Symmetry inflation: C_n with n > q (P3)
discrete_form: The full constellation C(L) is invariant under rotation by 2 pi / n with n strictly larger than the Newton-polygon q.
analytic_lift: CANDIDATE automorphism of the anti-Stokes skeleton: rotation by 2 pi / (n p / q) on the t-plane (after suitable rescaling) preserves the leading {c_i}. To upgrade to an automorphism of MW(L) one must verify it preserves the lower-order Q_i coefficients and formal monodromy.
caveats: Inflation may be broken by lower-order corrections in the irregular type.

invariant: Multi-edge factorisation chi = prod_alpha chi^{(alpha)} (Phase-III M1)
discrete_form: C(L) = bigsqcup_alpha C_alpha with one ring system per edge.
analytic_lift: Slope filtration of the formal connection. The Levelt-Turrittin decomposition splits L_formal as a direct sum L = bigoplus_alpha L_alpha, where each L_alpha is a single-slope summand. Each summand carries its own Stokes structure on its own anti-Stokes ray pattern (slope -p_alpha/q_alpha). The TOTAL anti-Stokes set is the union, but pairs (i, j) WITH i in C_alpha, j in C_beta, alpha != beta give Q_i - Q_j of slope max(slope_alpha, slope_beta) and their anti-Stokes contribution is determined by the LARGER slope's leading Q-coefficient (the smaller-slope contribution is invisible at leading order).
lift_strength: structural (slope filtration); needs cross-slope leading-term analysis
caveats: Phase-III's 'disjoint edges' is generic; collisions across edges define a new stratum.

discrete_form: For block-diagonal Phi = diag(L_1, ..., L_n), C(Phi) = bigsqcup_i C(L_i).
analytic_lift: Direct-sum splitting of MW(Phi) = prod_i MW(L_i). The Stokes matrices are block-diagonal. This applies ONLY to genuinely decoupled systems; coupled systems require additional invariants (off-diagonal Stokes couplings) not visible in the constellation.
lift_strength: exact for genuine direct sums; not applicable to general systems
caveats: All Phase-III SYS operators are explicit block diagonal; general coupled systems are out of scope.

discrete_form: chi_w(w) factors as chi_v(w^{q'}), giving effective (mu_q x mu_{q'})-equivariance.
analytic_lift: Iterated Levelt-Turrittin pullback: the connection requires a further ramified cover t -> tau, tau = t^{1/q'}, on which the irregular type polynomials in tau have degree p q'. Anti-Stokes rays multiply by q' (the inner ramification index). The wild character variety acquires a mu_{q'} symmetry inherited from the inner cover.
caveats: Cancellations in the iterated pullback may reduce effective q to q*q'/gcd or smaller.

discrete_form: Gal(Qbar/Q) acts on Roots(chi_w), permuting rings of C(L).
analytic_lift: Galois-equivariant locus of the wild character variety: when chi_w is defined over Q, the L-rational points of MW(L) form a closed subscheme invariant under Gal(Qbar/Q) action on rings. Cyclotomic chi_w give MW(L) over Q(zeta_n) for appropriate n.
caveats: Stokes constants are typically transcendental; only the discrete part of MW(L) is Galois-equivariant.
